claim: Government is giving free laptops and tablets to all college students under the Prime Minister Digital Education Scheme 2026.
explanation: No such scheme has been launched by the Ministry of Education. The viral link is a phishing site designed to harvest personal information.

claim: RBI has withdrawn Rs 500 currency notes from circulation starting next month.
explanation: Reserve Bank of India has confirmed that Rs 500 currency notes continue to be legal tender. RBI has issued no notification withdrawing them.

claim: Indian Railways is canceling all senior citizen train concession services permanently.
explanation: Concessions were suspended during COVID-19 pandemic for general categories and remain limited to specific categories (divyangjan, cancer patients); no new permanent cancellation order was issued.

claim: Old video of earthquake in Japan shared as recent tremblor in Delhi NCR.
explanation: The video footage is from the 2011 Fukushima earthquake in Japan and is falsely circulated claiming to be Delhi NCR tremors.

claim: WhatsApp message claims that calling emergency number 112 redirects users to paid call centers that charge Rs 500.
claimant: Viral Audio Clip and WhatsApp Forwards
explanation: 112 is India's toll-free unified emergency response support system (ERSS). It is completely free of charge across all telecom providers.

claim: Election Commission of India introduces voting via mobile SMS or online portal for upcoming state assembly elections.
explanation: The Election Commission of India has not permitted mobile phone or internet voting for general voters. Physical EVM polling remains the sole statutory voting method.

claim: UNESCO declares Indian National Anthem Jana Gana Mana as best national anthem in the world.
explanation: UNESCO has repeatedly clarified that it does not evaluate or declare rankings for national anthems of any country. This hoax has circulated online since 2008.

claim: Ministry of Health advisory warns public not to consume packaged milk due to chemical contamination.
claimant: Viral Voice Note on Social Media
explanation: No such advisory has been issued by FSSAI or the Ministry of Health. FSSAI conducts regular nationwide dairy surveillance.
